svg.title: This is the gentle-mesh condition. Equations (CAL1) and (CAL9) give (FCA4) and (RUN3). The stage order, power and support exponent stay nondecreasing, the protection exponent decreases, and (CAL2) gives the small-field threshold at every scale. These properties all belong to the same calendar. For volume, let di = Q r<i Lr = eτi. On every noninitial plateau (CAL4) gives VJ(i+1)(τi) ≤di, so any positive physical period pays its lattice-size requirements. Only finitely many steps belong to the initial plateau, since E →∞.
